The warehouse is filled with shelves and racks, and there are stacks of cardboard boxes on the left side of the image. On the right side, there is a red fire extinguisher mounted on a yellow pole. In the center of the warehouse, there are several pallets with blue water bottles on them. The floor is made of concrete and appears to be clean and well-maintained. The walls are painted white and there is an exit sign on the wall.
